description.summary: macOS Tahoe 26 Top Bar Global Menu Protocol

protocol.description: This protocol defines the communication between applications and the Quartz Top Menu Bar daemon: - Application bold menu and standard menus (File, Edit, View, Window, Help). - Option-dynamic menu item mutations in real time (e.g. Close -> Close All). - Help Search Rector for indexing menu actions and steering the floating blue pointer arrow. - Window list synchronization with checkmark (active) and diamond (minimized). - Rapid 0ms sliding between adjacent top-level menus and 120ms double-flash activation.

interface.name: zquartz_global_menu_manager_v1
interface.description: Factory interface for advertising and binding application menus to the centralized Top Menu Bar.

request.name: register_application_menu

description.summary: Register an application top-level menu hierarchy

request.description: Registers a global menu hierarchy for the given application ID.

arg.name: app_name
arg.summary: Display name displayed in bold next to Apple logo

interface.name: zquartz_global_menu_v1
interface.description: Controls an active application's menu tree in the Top Menu Bar.

description.summary: Bitmask of menu item visual states

entry.name: diamond
entry.summary: Item displays a diamond symbol (minimized window)

entry.name: separator
entry.summary: Item is a horizontal dividing line

entry.name: has_submenu
entry.summary: Item expands into a child submenu

description.summary: Modifier keys associated with menu shortcuts

request.name: begin_menu_definition

description.summary: Begin atomic transaction updating menu layout

request.description: Clients call this before issuing menu item declarations.

request.name: add_top_menu
request.description: Appends a top-level category (e.g. File, Edit, View, Window, Help) to the bar.

arg.name: menu_id
arg.summary: Unique integer ID for this menu

request.name: add_menu_item

description.summary: Add standard menu item to a category or submenu

request.description: Registers an individual clickable action item.

arg.name: parent_id
arg.summary: Parent menu ID or submenu ID

request.name: add_option_variant

description.summary: Register an Option-key mutation for an existing item

request.description: When the user presses Option, the item with target_item_id dynamically mutates its label and accelerator to alt_label and alt_modifiers.

arg.name: alt_label
arg.summary: Label shown when Option is depressed (e.g. 'Close All')

arg.name: alt_shortcut_modifiers
arg.summary: Modifiers shown when Option is held

request.name: update_window_list

description.summary: Synchronize app windows in the 'Window' menu footer

request.description: Populates the Window menu with active surfaces. The compositor places a checkmark next to the focused window and diamonds next to minimized windows.

request.name: commit_menu_definition

description.summary: Commit and render updated menu structure

request.description: Finalizes menu structure and activates it on the Top Menu Bar.

request.name: report_help_search_results

description.summary: Send Help menu search match back to the compositor

request.description: When the user types in the Help menu search box, the client searches its menu hierarchy and reports matched items for visual guidance.

event.name: item_activated

description.summary: Menu item was selected by user

event.description: Fired after the 120ms double-flash animation on item selection.

event.name: option_modifier_changed

description.summary: Compositor notifies client of Option key transition

event.description: Notifies client that Option key was pressed (1) or released (0) while a menu was open.

event.name: help_search_query

description.summary: User typed into the Help menu search bar

event.description: Prompts the application to search its menu command tree.

event.name: highlight_menu_item

description.summary: Target menu item found for Help search guidance

event.description: Sent by the Help Rector to automatically unfold submenus and point the animated floating blue arrow at the designated item.

arg.name: item_id
arg.summary: Item to point to with the floating arrow

arg.name: item_width
arg.summary: Item width for arrow offset calculation
